aboutGame.title: What is Murder Duels?
paragraphs: Murder Duels is a fast-paced first-person PvP game on Roblox developed by Breakfast. Players step onto duel pads, enter solo or team match formats from 1v1 through 4v4, and fight round by round with a knife and revolver until one side reaches five wins.

Beyond aim and movement, Murder Duels includes weapon abilities, cosmetic skins, cases, trading, limited collectibles, seasonal events, map updates, clans, and quality-of-life settings. The game rewards precise combat while giving players long-term goals through collecting, trading, and progression.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Murder Duels.

items.question: What is Murder Duels?
items.answer: Murder Duels is a Roblox first-person PvP dueling game by Breakfast where players fight with a knife and revolver in round-based 1v1 through 4v4 matches.

items.question: How do Murder Duels matches work?
items.answer: Murder Duels matches are played in short rounds. Players choose a duel format, use knife and revolver combat, and the first side to reach five round wins takes the match.

items.question: Does Murder Duels have codes?
items.answer: Murder Duels codes can reward free cases or special items. Players usually need to meet in-game requirements such as joining the developer group, liking the game, and reaching the required level before redeeming.

items.question: Can you trade in Murder Duels?
items.answer: Murder Duels includes trading for weapon skins and collectibles. Players should compare rarity, demand, limited supply, and item availability before accepting a trade.

items.question: What weapons are used in Murder Duels?
items.answer: Murder Duels centers on two core weapons: a knife for close pressure and a revolver for ranged accuracy. Both weapon types can have unique abilities and cosmetic skins.

items.question: Is Murder Duels on Roblox?
items.answer: Murder Duels is available on Roblox and is built around fast competitive duels, collectible weapon skins, maps, events, clans, and player trading.
